title: Document Generation Failure Investigation
description: Investigation guidance for document and template generation failures.
preconditions: Capture the earliest complete exception and stack trace
Identify the affected environment and server
Identify the template or document type where available
investigationSteps: Confirm whether the issue affects one request or multiple requests
Compare successful and failed template input data
Validate the selected template and template version
Check storage, permissions and output paths
Review recent template, application and configuration changes
mitigationSteps: Retry only after confirming the request is idempotent
Use a previously validated template version when approved
validationSteps: Generate a document using known-good test data
Confirm the output is stored or returned correctly
Confirm no new errors are produced
escalationCriteria: Template defect requires a template owner
Application code fails while building template input
Dependency is unavailable or returns unexpected results
